assay: bulk RNA-seq (BGISEQ-500, PE), human vastus lateralis biopsies; kallisto 0.46.1 counts on GRCh38.p13 GENCODE (S2.8.p1, S2.9.p1)
sample_inclusion: 30 recreationally active young men, randomized 15 CP (collagen peptides, 'verum' in GEO) / 15 PLA; biopsies at baseline, 1 h, 4 h, 24 h after one high-load knee-extension bout (S2.1.p1, S2.4.p1, S3.p1). GEO has 119 samples: subject ID17 (CP) has no 24 h sample.
primary_estimand: Within-subject change in skeletal-muscle gene expression after acute resistance exercise (1, 4, 24 h vs pre-exercise baseline) in each supplement arm, and the CP-vs-PLA difference in that change at each time point (S2.9.p1, S3.2.p1-S3.4.p1).
planned_contrasts: PLA: 1h/4h/24h vs baseline (S3.2.p1, S3.3.p1, Fig 3; reported as pathway NES only, no DEG counts)
CP: 1h/4h/24h vs baseline (S3.2.p1, S3.3.p1, Fig 3; pathway NES only)
CP vs PLA change at 1h/4h/24h (S2.9.p1 'comparison of changes between CP and placebo ... for every timepoint'; pathway NES only)
paper_method: voom logCPM + limma linear models (systemPipeR); fgsea / EnrichmentBrowser GSEA on KEGG (S2.9.p1, S2.9.p2)
paper_results: No DEG counts reported. Pathways: PI3K-Akt up at 1 h in both arms and at 4 h in CP only; MAPK up at 1 h and 4 h in both arms; CP > PLA for both at 4 h; mTOR not significant (S3.2.p1-S3.4.p1). Named genes in CP vs PLA at 4 h: ANGPT1, TGFB1 (S4.p3, S4.p6).
